title: Use an unfitted ordinary scalar cumulant transport at four values
statement: For every scalar ell-Lipschitz h,draw four iid values V_i=h(G_i),vhat=(V1-V2)^2/2,mhat=(V1-V2)^2(V1-V3),and output Y=V0+(1-vhat/2)Z-(mhat/6)(Z^2-1)+aW,a>0. This positive pushforward preserves mu and satisfies TV(Y,N(mu,1+a^2))<=min(1,19D4 ell^4/[24(1+a^2)^2]+phi(1)[3ell^4/4+8ell^6/3]/a^2),D4=||phi fourth derivative||_1/2.

requires: Six independent scalar Gaussians and paid reserve a
provides: Exactly4 original values,constant arithmetic/storage,no fit or mean/derivative/kernel oracle
Actual coefficient moments<=3ell^4 and48ell^6,not coefficients substituted as deterministic inside a law
Physical-noise split b^2+a^2=sigma^2 and scaled formula in original
assumptions: Full smoothed-event Taylor proof,not moment matching
Small Lipschitz/noise quartic regime,not arbitrary accuracy at fixed ratio
Negative coefficient of Z does not negate positivity of an ordinary random-variable map
costs: Exact-real primitives;finite precision needs common rounding/error accounting
Direct vector rank-one correction already costs ell^4d(d+2)/4 in second moment
contract.units: Full scalar-law TV and original scalar values
contract.obstruction: Cannot extend coordinatewise to a vector joint-law theorem;no best general sampler,priority or practical advantage.

evidence.quote: works for every scalar globally Lipschitz source
evidence.range_scope: Unfitted ordinary four-value scalar cumulant transport with full-law quartic bound;no vector transfer.

evidence.quote: Neither return completes the general N687
evidence.range_scope: Completed separate first-return Q52=A/Q17=B audit of actual arguments/code and own replays;does not cover later continuations.

body: This equal-information ordinary alternative prevents treating a useful fitted S as free. Known template means can yield an even stronger exact one-query marginal sampler.

review.scope: Actual completed audit is a separate version-bound overlay.
